name: Migraine
overview: Migraine is a recurring neurological disorder with moderate-to-severe headache, often one-sided, with nausea and sensitivity to light or sound. It affects productivity and quality of life but responds well to tailored treatment.
symptoms: Aura (visual disturbances) in some patients before headache
causes: Genetic predisposition with cortical spreading depression
Triggers: hormones, sleep change, certain foods, stress
Not caused by a single structural lesion in typical migraine
diagnosis: Neuroimaging if atypical features or red flags
treatment: Preventive: propranolol, topiramate, amitriptyline for frequent attacks
CGRP inhibitors in selected refractory cases

faq.question: Can I rely on this Migraine information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: What should I do if Migraine symptoms worsen suddenly?
faq.answer: Seek urgent medical care, especially if severe pain, breathing difficulty, confusion, or high fever develops.
